acceptedFindings.title: Analysis is unbound exploratory, not suitable for paper-ready interpretation
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json:resultPosture.status=exploratory_standard_table
stats-run.json:binding.status=unbound
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without a pre-registered analysis plan or a bound method-selection artifact, the study lacks methodological governance. The results are explicitly marked as not supporting paper-ready conclusions. Promoting this to a manuscript misrepresents the evidence level.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either bind the analysis to a pre-specified protocol and analysis spec, or downgrade the output to an exploratory data summary. If resubmitted as a full study, provide a detailed analysis plan with confounder adjustment, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and a hypothesis testing framework.

acceptedFindings.title: Unbound analysis prevents any confirmatory or causal interpretation
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json: binding.status=unbound
stats-run.json: resultPosture.status=exploratory_standard_table
stats-qa.json: check binding-status warning
stats-qa.json: result-posture warning
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without a binding to a method-selection artifact or AnalysisSpec, the analysis lacks a pre-registered protocol, making it purely exploratory and unsuitable for paper-ready claims or promotion.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either create and bind a retrospective analysis specification with appropriate caveats, or reclassify the entire output as exploratory and remove any language suggesting confirmatory findings.

acceptedFindings.title: No confounders or covariates included in the comparison
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json:variables = ['outcome_cont','treatment']
manuscript.md: no mention of covariates
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: In an observational study, treatment groups may differ systematically on other prognostic factors. Without adjustment or balancing, the observed difference cannot be attributed to the treatment. The analysis provides only a raw bivariate association, which is highly susceptible to confounding.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Identify potential confounders (demographics, baseline characteristics) and include them in a multivariable model or use propensity matching/stratification. Document variable selection and provide adjusted effect estimates with uncertainty intervals.

acceptedFindings.title: Manuscript omits key effect estimates and misreports p-value
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md:Results: only test statistic and p=0.0000
stats-run.json:estimates includes medians, sample sizes
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The reader cannot assess the magnitude of the difference. Reporting p=0.0000 is misleading and violates standard reporting practices (should be <0.001 or exact small number).
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report medians, IQRs, sample sizes, and an appropriate effect size (e.g., probability of superiority). Use correct p-value notation (p < 0.001) and include confidence intervals if computable.

acceptedFindings.title: Mann-Whitney test applied without verifying the equal-shape assumption
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json:diagnostics.ties_possible=true
manuscript.md: no distribution diagnostics
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The test's interpretation as a median difference depends on the assumption that the two distributions are identically shaped under the null. Ties alone do not validate this. Violation can lead to misinterpretation of the test result.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide plots of the two distributions (overlaid histograms or density plots) and comment on shape similarity. Consider alternative tests (e.g., permutation test, quantile regression) or report the test as a stochastic dominance test rather than a median test.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: diagnostics.json contains only test name and ties_possible

acceptedFindings.title: Cohort derivation and missing data handling not documented
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: states complete-case N=240 without exclusion flow
no artifact on eligibility or missingness patterns
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Complete-case analysis assumes missingness is completely at random, which is rarely true. Without knowing how the final 240 were selected, selection bias cannot be assessed.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a STROBE-like flow diagram showing starting sample, exclusions (with reasons), and final analytic sample. Conduct a missingness analysis (e.g., compare included vs excluded) and consider sensitivity analysis (e.g., multiple imputation).
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: No file in artifacts describes cohort flow.

acceptedFindings.title: Limited reproducibility: no raw data or code provided
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json: only summary estimates and diagnostics
manuscript.md: refers to local run directory
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The study cannot be independently verified or rerun without access to the original data and the exact code used. Reproducibility is a cornerstone of credible research.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Deposit a de-identified or synthetic version of the dataset (if allowed) and the analysis script (e.g., R/Python code) in a persistent repository, or provide a detailed computational notebook.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: No .csv or script file present among artifacts beyond summary tables.

acceptedFindings.title: Cohort construction is opaque and unverifiable
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: "The cohort definition was read from available run artifacts"
absence of any cohort specification artifact
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria, missingness handling, and a flow diagram, the sample's representativeness and potential selection biases cannot be evaluated.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Document the cohort assembly process, including all eligibility rules, how missing data were handled, and the final sample derivation. Provide a STROBE-style flow chart if applicable.

acceptedFindings.title: No effect size or confidence interval reported
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json: estimates array contains only medians, test statistic, and p-value
manuscript.md: reports only p-value
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Reporting only a p-value overstates the role of statistical significance and ignores practical importance. For Mann-Whitney, common effect sizes (e.g., Cliff's delta, rank-biserial correlation) are essential.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Compute and report appropriate effect sizes with confidence intervals, such as the Hodges-Lehmann shift estimate or probability of superiority, alongside the p-value.

acceptedFindings.title: Mann-Whitney assumptions and ties handling not addressed
evidenceRefs: diagnostics.json: ties_possible=true, no further detail
stats-run.json: no assumption parameters
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The test assumes independent samples and, for a location shift interpretation, similar distribution shapes. Ties inflate p-values unless properly corrected. Ignoring these can lead to spurious significance.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Check and report independence, shape similarity (e.g., via visual diagnostics), and explicitly state the method used to handle ties (exact or continuity correction). If assumptions are violated, consider alternative analyses.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Verify that diagnostics.json includes shape and independence checks; otherwise consider test invalid.

acceptedFindings.title: Manuscript contains internal contradictions and self-undermining statements
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: Limitations section states "No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found" and "No reader-facing report was available for claim alignment" while the manuscript itself is present
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: These contradictions make the manuscript appear uncurated and confuse readers about what evidence is being presented. They undermine trust in the reporting process.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Edit the manuscript to remove contradictory statements and ensure a single, coherent narrative that accurately reflects the available artifacts.

acceptedFindings.title: No access to underlying data impedes reproducibility
evidenceRefs: absence of data file or link in artifact list
manuscript.md: mentions row-level data allowed but no provision of de-identified copy
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without data, independent verification of results is impossible. Even with PHI concerns, a synthetic or de-identified dataset should be supplied.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a de-identified or synthetic dataset with a data dictionary, or detailed instructions and ethics approvals for accessing the original data.

acceptedFindings.title: Extremely small p-value (1.86e-9) lacks plausibility scrutiny
evidenceRefs: stats-run.json: p_value=1.8599038046060571e-9
absence of data distribution plots or outlier analysis
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Such a small p-value with moderate sample sizes (N=240) is rare and could indicate data artifacts, extreme non-normality, or coding errors. Without diagnostic checks, the result may be spurious.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Produce histograms, boxplots, and summary statistics per group. Check for data entry errors, extreme outliers, or clustering. If the result is valid, explain the clinical or biological basis for such a strong separation.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Recompute test after randomly perturbing a few values to see if p-value remains stable; if it changes drastically, suspect data issues.

acceptedFindings.title: No outlier or distributional checks beyond ties flag
evidenceRefs: diagnostics.json: only ties_possible
figure-qa.json: boxplot present but no outlier audit
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Extreme outliers could distort medians and inflate the test statistic, leading to false confidence in the result.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add a table or figure summarizing distributional features (range, IQR, skewness, number of outliers) and discuss any data integrity concerns.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: No artifact contains outlier summary or data range.

absence of any literature review artifact
